scope: DM1 V1 turn left/right source mechanics, direction state, endpoint render presentation, movement/wall interaction

citations.claim: movement arrows map click zones to turn-left/turn-right and four movement commands
queue gate blocks only movement commands C003..C006; turns dispatch to F0365
turn command sets stop-waiting, highlights arrow, stairs take-stairs, otherwise sensors wrap one normalized 90-degree F0284 direction mutation
F0284 computes delta, rotates champion Cell/Direction by delta, stores G0308_i_PartyDirection
main loop redraw uses current G0308_i_PartyDirection after command processing
command processing loop stops after G0321_B_StopWaitingForPlayerInput is set by turn
viewport presentation is a requested draw plus vertical blank wait, not a multi-frame yaw animation loop
direction constants use north/east/south/west vector tables

firestaffEvidence.claim: guarded V1 presentation turning seam stores one-step 90-degree endpoint render semantics with no wall block check
turn dispatch uses guarded M11 V1 seam and handles stairs-before-turn source sequence
ctest asserts direction delta, one endpoint frame, no intermediate yaw frames, no wall block, V1 guard, and champion pose rotation

answers.facingDirectionStorage: G0308_i_PartyDirection equivalent PartyState_Compat.direction; champion Direction/Cell rotate by delta
answers.turnAnimationFrames: 1 endpoint viewport presentation; 0 intermediate yaw frames; draw request waits for vertical blank
answers.movementInteraction: movement cooldown gate applies only C003..C006, so turns can dispatch while movement is disabled; command loop stops after turn sets G0321
answers.wallBlocking: none for turning; only stairs special-case on current square before normal turn
